About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity - Senior Tax Administrator I (Remote - USA / Canada)

Wrapbook is the entertainment industry's leading payroll and employer-of-record (EOR) platform. Our Tax Operations team keeps unemployment, payroll tax, and incentive work accurate, compliant, and on time for productions and the workers they employ.

We are looking for a Senior Tax Administrator to be the operational owner of Tax Operations’ day-to-day work. You will make sure the reporting is built, automated, and accurate, and you will own the agents that let the team work smarter, not harder. You will document core workflows, build and maintain the agentic tools the team relies on, and decide where a person stays in the loop. You will own the claims KPI dashboard, work with our SUI program manager to cut claim volume at the source, and handle employment and income verifications. You will also be the generalist who steps in on SUTA corrections, audits, payroll tax filings, and tax incentives work when someone is out or volume spikes.

What You'll Do

  • Document core workflows and how the team uses its systems, so the work is repeatable and nothing lives in one person’s head

  • Own mail and notice routing, including duplicate state notices, to a turnaround standard

  • Own the handoffs with our SUI program manager to reduce claim volume at the source: send pseudo-correction letters to states when employees file under a production company instead of Wrapbook, maintain the LLC-to-EOR correction agent for the People team, and own the employee how-to-file guide

  • Own Tax Operations reporting end to end: build it, automate it, and keep it accurate. Reconcile every report to source data before it reaches leadership, and fix the root cause when numbers don’t tie. Examples include UI claims status, monthly KPI reporting, New Jersey SB 422 compliance reporting, BLS reporting, and film state tax incentive reporting. Work with analytics, AI Ops, and product to automate it

  • Own the claims KPI dashboard, and explain the trend and drivers behind the numbers

  • Own the team’s agents from build to retirement. Test changes before they ship, fix what breaks, and document how each one works. Keep a simple inventory (purpose, owner, last tested), measure the hours saved or volume handled, and retire what isn’t used. Work with AI Ops on more advanced builds

  • Decide what to automate and where a person stays in the loop, and check agent output against source data before it is used

  • Own the rollout of each new agent or process to the team, with training and an SOP, and turn recurring problems into repeatable SOPs

  • Handle employment and income verifications (VOE)

  • Step in on processing SUTA corrections, audits, payroll tax filings, payments, and agency notices across states when someone on the team is out or workload spikes

  • Support Tax Incentives: help prepare filings, reconciliations, and audit-ready reports, and act as the backup for the Incentives analyst

  • Own the handoffs with the People team, Payroll Operations, Support, Success, AI Ops, and EPD: resolve cross-team issues directly and flag blockers early

What You'll Have:

Required

  • 4+ years of experience in payroll tax or tax operations, ideally at an EOR, PEO, or payroll provider

  • Hands-on experience with state agency notices

  • Experience building reporting or dashboards from payroll or tax data and reconciling them to source

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining an agent or workflow that your team uses, with output checked against source data before it ships and a clear measure of the time or volume it saves

  • Experience owning a case queue or workstream and improving it through process changes, with SOPs others can follow

  • Real AI building skills, not just AI usage: you have built or refined agents or workflows that other people use, and you check their output before it ships

  • Ability to use data to explain trends and root causes, and to bring a proposed fix instead of just the problem

  • Sound judgment on ambiguous or non-routine work, and the habit of escalating with a recommendation

  • Strong written communication in a remote, document-heavy environment

Preferred

  • Experience with multi-state payroll tax filings and payments

  • Experience with tax incentives filings or reconciliations

  • Experience in payroll

  • Experience with Salesforce

  • Experience with Dust, Claude, or similar agent tools


Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

  • Health and Dental benefits

  • Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

  • Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

  • Learning and Development opportunities

  • Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service

Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.

Apply Now

Have we got your attention? Submit your application today and a member of our Talent team will be in touch with you shortly!
